race.comment: WILLASTON (15) holds the strongest recent form line after closing into third in a BM58 at Balaklava, beaten just over a length after having difficulty obtaining clear running at the 200m. He now drops to BM54 grade and has placed twice from three tries at this track and distance, so he sets a solid benchmark. FLYIN' FOR US (5) resumes and brings the best course profile, with three wins and a placing from five starts at this track, plus a recent Morphettville trial to bring him on. Key runner. SUMAMBISTARR (13) returns from a ten-month break, but she is a proven track-and-trip winner and has a strong jockey-horse record with one win and four placings from seven starts. SCANDALIST (16) has to rebound from two plain Gawler runs, yet the latest was better than it reads after racing wide throughout, and her 1200m record gives her a realistic way back into the race.
